_comment: E9 f16 diagnosis only; no arithmetic change or gate closure. One L4, $1.50 cumulative,95min VM/2.25h driver. Explicit incomplete receipt on timeout; raw journals on retained storage until terminal fetch.

jobs.name: e9_f16_diagnosis
cmd:
set -euo pipefail
out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"
for f in ember.tgz graph_ir_original.cpp COMMITS INPUT_SHA256SUMS f16_diagnosis_vm.sh; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f" || exit 1; done
rc=0
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=180s 95m bash /content/f16_diagnosis_vm.sh "$out" || rc=$?
python3 - "$out" "$rc" <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,sys,zipfile
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);rc=int(sys.argv[2]);report=out/'diagnosis_report.json'
if not report.exists():
 report.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'INCOMPLETE','complete':False,'e9_closed':False,'exit_code':rc})+chr(10))
r=json.loads(report.read_text());complete=rc==0 and r.get('status')=='DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE'
if not (out/'vm.log').is_file() or not (out/'out.zip').is_file():
 raise RuntimeError('missing terminal log/raw archive; refuse transport success')
with zipfile.ZipFile(out/'out.zip') as archive:
 if complete and archive.read('diagnosis/diagnosis_report.json')!=report.read_bytes():
  raise RuntimeError('final raw archive report differs; refuse transport success')
execution={'diagnostic_only':True,'exit_code':rc,'complete':complete,'e9_closed':False,'scientific_result':r.get('status')}
(out/'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(execution)+chr(10))
assert json.loads((out/'execution.json').read_text())==execution
PY
# FINISHED means evidence transport only, including valid negatives/incomplete diagnostics.
exit 0
